collectionDescription: Protected Areas 2021 provides reliable, high-resolution land use and land cover data for 25,011 terrestrial Natura 2000 and Emerald sites for the 2021 reference year in EEA32 countries (EU, EFTA) and the United Kingdom, covering a total of 821,000 km2 of land surface across Europe.

layers.longDescription: Provides detailed land cover and land use information for 59 thematic classes in selected Natura2000 and Emerald sites for the 2021 reference year. The dataset has a Minimum Mapping Unit (MMU) of 0.5 ha and a Minimum Mapping Width (MMW) of 10 m and is available as vector data.
